plan.commit_message:
Add task list with Turbo Stream toast on creation

List tasks at / from a JSON-file repository and add a Turbo form that
POSTs to /tasks, returning a composed turbo-stream that appends the new
row and a success toast. Add a quick-add action using the bundle bare
toast() shortcut. Seed a locked fixture task for upcoming deletion work.
No session, no Doctrine, no Form component.
